messages:
secops: :warning: Heads up — our scanning pipeline flagged symlinked private credentials inside recent build artifacts stored in s3://redwood-builds/prod/2026-03-23. This looks like a packaging bug that dereferenced keys from the builder host rather than copying them. Please treat as high priority and assume affected keys need rotation.

jordan (infra): Can you list which keys exactly? service accounts, SSH keys, or both?

secops: Primarily SSH private keys and a handful of older service-account JSON blobs that were accidentally included via symlink. Preliminary scan shows ~7 artifacts across two builders. We pushed a containment rule to block public access to those objects; infra please confirm ACLs.

leah (build): ack — we rolled back the last builder image and disabled the packaging step that follows symlink resolution. Investigating why 'tar -h' (follow symlinks) ended up in the pipeline.

sam (oncall): Quick detection commands for teams: run this locally in any build workspace to find symlinked private keys:

```
# find symlinked private keys under repo/build
find . -type l -printf "%p -> %l\n" | grep -E "id_rsa|id_ed25519|service-account.*json"
# or detect files that resolve outside the build dir
while read L; do REAL=$(readlink -f "$L"); [[ "$REAL" != $(pwd)* ]] && echo "$L -> $REAL"; done < <(find . -type l)
```

devex-bot: Note: CI job redwood-ci/sanitize-artifacts v2 has been temporarily disabled for flaky uploads. Re-enabling after patch.

alice (sre): Infra: confirm ACL change on those 7 S3 objects and add object-level access logs for the container that pulled them. Also create an allowlist for artifact downloads for next 48h.

jordan (infra): ACLs set to private, bucket policy tightened, and we attached a lifecycle tag 'incident-2245567890' for forensic hold. Access logs enabled (will take ~10m to populate).

secops: Action items (all teams):
- Immediate: Rotate all SSH keys that were deployed by the affected builders and revoke any active sessions using them.
- Rotate: Any service-account JSONs referenced in those artifacts — create new keys and perform a short lived token migration.
- Patch: Update packaging scripts to never follow symlinks (use tar with --no-follow-symlinks / copy files instead).
- Audit: Run the find commands from Sam across all builder workspaces and CI images within 24 hours.
- Postmortem: Build team to open a CL with root cause and remediation steps in the infra board.

leah (build): Will publish an immediate patch and a test that fails the build if symlinks are detected. Pushing in ~30m.

jordan (infra): I'll coordinate a scoped key rotation plan for affected 3rd-party integrations and update the incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2245567890

sam (oncall): For quick rotation examples:
```
# rotate SSH key for service 'deploy-bot'
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /tmp/deploy-bot.new -N "" && ssh-copy-id -i /tmp/deploy-bot.new.pub deploy@host
# revoke GCP JSON key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-account@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

secops: Deadline: complete discovery + rotations for any keys that show up in artifact scans within 48 hours. Post a follow-up in this thread when done. If you find external exposure (public bucket access before containment) escalate to me and legal immediately.

alice (sre): Noted. I'll monitor the fallback routes and enable extra alerting on auth failures that could indicate stale keys being used.

leah (build): Patch submitted: MR #6421. Added test and lib routine to copy rather than follow symlinks. Will also add a regression test for archived artifacts.

jordan (infra): Confirmed rotations for infra-owned keys started. Will ping once completed.

secops: Thanks everyone. Please report status updates here. If you need a war-room, react with :rotating_light: and I'll spawn a call.

jordan (infra): :rotating_light: starting key rotations now, will update by EOD.

leah (build): Patch promoted to canary builders, initial canary passed. Rolling to prod builders next.

sam (oncall): All scans across CI images completed — two additional symlinked JSONs found and removed. Rotations in-progress for those two.

secops: Last note — security policy update incoming: enforcement for packaging pipelines to run an artifact-sanitizer step before any public upload. Expect a doc + automation in the next 72h.

leah (build): Good idea. I'll coordinate the sanitizer integration with devex.

secops: Thread closed for now; reopen if new findings.
